answer: The garnet pair with the highest IRB CZ fidelity is QB12-QB17, at 0.99878 (0.9987773, uncertainty 0.00037). The source is metrics.irb.cz.slepian_crf.QB12__QB17.fidelity:par=d2 in the quality metric set 10103bc2-7afc-4288-8250-dab49f8dfc57. That set describes the current default calibration set, edea61a8-0087-446a-836a-66ff46ee5413. The runner-up is QB12-QB7 at 0.9987763, which is lower by about 1e-6. That gap is well inside the uncertainty. The DQA lists QB12-QB17 as a calibrated cz locus. I ran the Bell circuit on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The serialized circuit uses prx on QB12 and QB17, then cz on (QB12, QB17), then measure on QB12 (clbit 0) and QB17 (clbit 1). The final job is 01a15f3b-0567-77b8-acd1-ac4f4eb7c49d. Its counts are 00: 58 and 11: 42. I also submitted an earlier mock job, 01a15f3a-99ee-7394-82d6-5c270a80b9c8, which returned 11: 51 and 00: 49. A faulty check in my own script said that job used QB19 and QB20, so I can't confirm which qubits it measured. I resubmitted with the serialized circuit checked first. No real QPU jobs were run, so no credits were used.
